s: Din nokrim hammebiim ketabim beshabbat ubo y"b seipim: muttar lishloach iggeret o shear chapatzim vekelim beyad nokri apillu beereb shabbat samuk lachasheka, kol sheyyotze mippetach beto shel yisrael mibbeod yom, vehu sheqqatzatz lo damim biskar holakato, sheaz eno oseh bishbil hayyisrael ella bishbil atzmo leqabbel hassakar sheqqatzatz lo, veeno nireh kishlucho shel yisrael. Ubilbad shello yomar lo sheyyelek gam beshabbat, sheamira lenokri shebut ap sheomer lo qodem hashshabbat. Veken lo yomar lo reeh shettehe sham beechad beshabbat o bashsheni vekayyotze bazeh im yadua lo shei epshar lo lihyot az sham im lo sheyyelek gam beshabbat, shehare zeh keomer lo lek beshabbat:

Veim lo qatzatz lo sekar hahalika — hare hannokri toreach bishbil yisrael, lepikak asur leshallecho apillu beyom rishon, ella im ken yesh shahut sheyyukal lehaggia qodem hashshabbat labbayit harishon hassamuk lachoma shebbair shennishtallach lesham, sheaz ap im echar darko veholek gam beshabbat — en bekak kelum, shehalika zo enah mechamat hayyisrael ella mechamat atzmo. Veap sheepshar sheyyitztarek lelek beshabbat mibbayit harishon hassamuk lachoma shebbeotah hair ad bayit shel mi shetztzarik litten haiggeret leyado, mikkol maqom kevan sheen kan issur ella middibre soperim — tolin lehaqel lomar sheoto adam shetztzarik litten haiggeret leyado hu dar babbayit hassamuk lachoma:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmeshalleach haiggeret leadam qabua sheyyesh beotah ir shehu meqabbetz kol haiggerot hashsheluchot lesham venotelan vesholechan al yede shelucho kol iggeret lemi shennikteba elayv, vezehu hanniqra "be doar", shekkol ketab elayv yubal, ukeshehu qabua bair azay muttar lishloach elayv iggeret apillu beereb shabbat al yede nokri shello qatzatz lo sakar, kol sheyyesh shahut lehaggia elayv mibbeod yom. Abal im en be doar qabua beotah hair sheshsholeach lesham, vetzarik hannokri beatzmo lehaggia haiggeret leyad mi shennikteba elayv — asur leshallecho apillu beyom rishon, ap al pi sheyyesh shahut lehaggia leotah hair harbeh qodem hashshabbat, mikkol maqom yesh lachush shemma lo yimtza oto adam bebeto veyitztarek lelek acharayv, veshemma yitztarek lelek acharayv gam beshabbat. Umikkol maqom, im hu derek qarob, kegon mahalak yom echad, umeshallecho beyom b' o g' — yesh lehattir, sheap im lo yimtza haish bebeto — yesh lo shahut harbeh laleket qodem hashshabbat:
Vekol zeh keshello qatzatz, abal im qatzatz muttar leshallecho apillu leir sheen sham be doar, vaapillu hi derek rechoqa meod, vaapillu yotze mibbeto ereb shabbat im chasheka:

Veyesh omerim sheapillu lo qatzatz en issur leshallecho ella beereb shabbat, dekevan shemmeshallecho samuk leshabbat hare nireh keillu omer lo lelek beshabbat, lepikak tzarik sheyyehe shahut bayyom sheyyukal lehaggia mibbeod yom labbayit hassamuk lachoma shebbeotah hair im qabua sham be doar. Veim lo qabua sham be doar — asur leshallecho beereb shabbat ella im ken qatzatz. Abal keshemmeshallecho bed' veHashem, o qodem laken, kevan shehu muplag lipne hashshabbat — en nireh keomer lo lelek beshabbat, ulepikak ap al pi shello qatzatz muttar leshallecho apillu lederek rechoqa meod, ap al pi sheen be doar qabua beotah hair. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem im tzerikim lekak:

En chilluq ben sheqqabua be doar beotah hair lesheeno qabua ella beiggeret shehi ketab yad yisrael, shennikkar lakkol shehi shel yisrael, ukeshehannokri molikah beshabbat achar haish shennishlecha elayv yesh qetzat marit haayin, sheyyomru shebbeshabbat netanah lo hayyisrael leholikah, veap al pi ken keshemmeshallecho muplag lipne hashshabbat — lo hechemiru kol kak lachush lemarit haayin kazeh lepi sebara haacharona shennitbaer, ukesheqqatzatz lo hechemiru ledibre hakkol. Abal im hi ketab yad nokri, vehu haddin shear chapatzim sheenam nikkarim lakkol shehem shel yisrael — muttar leshallecham apillu beereb shabbat ledibre hakkol, kol sheyyesh shahut bayyom sheyyukal lehaggia mibbeod yom labbayit hassamuk lachoma shebbeotah hair sheshsholecham lesham, sheap im lo yimtza haish bebeto veyitztarek lelek acharayv beshabbat — en bekak kelum, kevan shebbeshaa shehayyisrael meshallecho en haddabar yadua lo shello yimtza bebeto, vahare meshallecho bishlichut sheepshar legomrah mibbeod yom, ukesheholek achar kak gam beshabbat eno nireh kishlucho shel yisrael, kevan shebbeshaa sheshshelacho lo haya yadua sheyyitztarek lelek beshabbat:

Im sekaro leyamim dabar qatzub lekol yom bahalikato vachazirato, ella sheeno maqpid immo matay yelek — asur lesokro velitten haiggeret leyado beereb shabbat, deshemma yetze beshabbat vihe nireh keillu tzivvahu lelek beshabbat, kevan shessekaro leyamim usekaro samuk leshabbat. Abal bed' veHashem muttar lesokro leyamim velitten lo az haiggeret, hoil veeno maqpid immo beezeh yom yelek — kesheyyelek beshabbat eno nireh kishlucho. Veap shessekaro leyamim, eno domeh liskir yom, hoil veqibbel alayv kol meleket holakat haiggeret — hare zeh domeh leqabbelan (ayyen simman rm"g veram"d):

Im amar lehannokri sheyyitten lo sekaro, ap al pi shello peresh kamma yitten lo — hare zeh keillu qatzatz veqatzab lo, sheddaat hannokri semuka shebbevadday yitten lo sekaro kepi mah sheyyitpashsher immo achar kak, ubishbil tobat atzmo hu toreach. Abal im lo amar lo beperush sheyyitten lo sekaro, ella shehannokri meatzmo yodea sheyyeshallem lo — en zeh kelum, sheen daat hannokri semuka bevadday al hassakar hahu, sheyyesh sapeq belibbo shemma lo yitten lo, ubishbil hayyisrael hu toreach:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu metzappeh umamtin letashlum sakar veen dato semuka alayv bevadday, abal im eno metzappeh kelal letashlum sakar ella oseh bechinnam — min hassetam oseh ken leshallem gemul leyisrael al hattoba sheqqibbel mimmennu kebar, vahare zeh keoseh bishbil sakar. Veyesh choleqin al zeh, im lo shehannokri meelayv matchil lomar lehayyisrael sheyyelek lo bechinnam, sheaz bevadday dato bishbil tobat hanaa sheqqibbel mimmennu kebar. Vetob lehachamir kedibrehem:

Abal lishloach iggeret bechinnam beereb shabbat beyad abdo hassakur lo leshana o lishtayim lekol hammelakot sheyyitztarek betok meshek zeman sekiruto — ledibre hakkol asur, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"d, shehaiqqar kehaoserin bezeh, ayyen sham hattaam. Umikkol maqom, bed' veHashem yesh lehattir lishloach apillu shello beet hatztzorek, kevan sheyyesh mattirim biskir shana sheoseh melaka bishbil yisrael kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"d, veap al pi sheen dibrehem iqqar, mikkol maqom yesh letzarep dibrehem ledibre haomerim shebbed' veHashem muttar lishloach iggeret bekol inyan ap al pi shello qatzatz kelal, velismok al zeh lehaqel legamre ap shello beet hatztzorek:

Abal im en hannokri sakur lo lekol hammelakot sheyyitztarek, ella lishloach beyado iggerot bilbad bekol et sheyyitztarek lishloach betok meshek hazzeman sekiravato — muttar lishloach beyado apillu beereb shabbat, al derek shennitbaer besimman rm"d, ayyen sham hattaam:

Kol maqom sheasur lishloach mippene shello qatzatz, ap im hannokri holek meatzmo leotah hair sheyyesh lo derek lesham — yesh lehachamir shello lishloach beyado keshello qatzatz, sheap sheeno toreach kelum bahalika bishbil yisrael, mikkol maqom mah shehu motzi haiggeret mereshut lirshut umaabirah d' ammot birshut harabbim, o apillu bekarmelit, hu oseh melakot ellu bishbil yisrael keshello qatzatz. Umikkol maqom, im yesh shahut lehaggia lesham qodem hashshabbat — muttar lishloach beyado ap al pi sheen be doar qabua sham, lepi sheap im lo yimtza haish bebeto — lo yelek acharayv kelal, kevan sheen lo derek lesham, vehu eno nose iggeret zo belo qetzitza ella mechamat sheyyesh lo derek lesham:
